changchun-2007.notes: Source 2 has 109 distinct team rows (the earlier reader recorded 100); the lodging notice in the website says 104 teams were to compete on site, so no teams fact is given. Source 3 is a qualification/allocation list (66 universities, 101 team slots), not a list of registered teams; teams is the closest role. Our website copy contains 100 pages of the Jilin Provincial Internet Contest (07jilin), a different event.

sources.evidence: Pages titled 第32届ACM-ICPC亚洲区长春赛区预选赛 (English: 32nd ACM-ICPC Asia Regional Changchun Site) with introduction, schedule of 3-6 November 2007, registration, a news page and results pages.
PC^2 summary table of 109 team rows with Rank, Name, Solved, Time, columns A to I and a total, last updated Mon Nov 05 14:26 2007.
Page headed 网络赛选拔结果 with admission rules and a table of 66 universities with their number of on-site teams, no results.

changchun-2012.notes: Source 2 has 180 teams (8 starred unofficial) while the standings of source 4 have 172. Source 1 is a mixed site of the host; its seed page is not about the contest.

sources.evidence: The site holds the blog, schedule, rules, venue, team-quota and award pages of the 2012 ACM-ICPC Asia Regional Contest (Changchun Site) at Northeast Normal University, alongside material of other years and projects.
Ranklist table titled 2012 长春赛区现场赛 with 180 team rows, columns S#, School, Rk, Team, Slv., Time and A to K with tries and time per problem.
The page shows only 'One moment, Loading...' and empty placeholder fields for team, school, coach and members; our copy holds no ranking data.

changchun-2013.notes: Site front page states 180 teams (177 official), 15 gold, 30 silver and 63 bronze; the scoreboard lists 181 rows and says 16, 31 and 64. The site's one-page PDF cc2013.pdf is an image scan read only by English OCR; its content matches the Word invitation as far as legible.

sources.evidence: The index page is headed 'The 2013 ACM-ICPC Asia Changchun Regional Contest' and gives the 7-8 December 2013 dates, the Jilin University venue and the contest rules and results links, with PDF notices of the same contest.
Ranklist table titled 2013 长春赛区现场赛 with 181 team rows, columns S#, School, Rk, Team, Slv., Time and A to J with tries and time per problem.

changchun-2015.notes: Sources 4 and 9 have no stored copy, but both pages are inside the crawl of source 1. The scoreboard has 220 teams, the standings from the ICPC data 215.
